## AgentMesh

AgentMesh is designed around the complete task rather than a single prompt. Its product model combines context, reasoning, authorised tools, execution, evaluation and human control.

HFL Tech presents AgentMesh as India's first super intelligent system and as a Made in India product built for a global market. These are company positioning statements; technical capability and comparative performance should be evaluated from the product documentation and evidence published by HFL Tech.

The public browser reference runtime is a demonstrable implementation and currently reports 6/6 deterministic self-tests passing. This does not by itself establish production scale, customer usage or benchmark superiority.

## Company

Legal name: HFL Tech Private Limited
Founder: Pavan Kumar BN
Flagship product: AgentMesh
Founder location: Mysuru, Karnataka, India

## HFL ecosystem

HFL Tech is part of a wider HFL ecosystem that includes HFL Foundation, HFL Education Trust, HFL Community and HFL Cyber Team. AgentMesh is the flagship HFL Tech product; Flux AI and other initiatives have separate product/project surfaces.

## Pricing

Public AgentMesh plans are presented in USD: Basic from $1, Pro from $3 and Pro Max from $10. Pricing and availability may change; the live pricing page is authoritative.
